sources.description: Framed photographic advisor card with actual exterior transparency; retain opaque photo/frame/note and original soft exterior shadow. The original is a tilted dark rectangular photo frame with an opaque grey photographic backing. Preserve the aged cream note overlapping the lower-right face/shoulder area, with tiny unreadable header strokes kept indistinct, not invented as readable text. Only outside the combined photo/frame/note is transparent, with its soft shadow. Older near-frontal figure in a tall broad dark brown/navy hat with visible small gold front badge and grey-blue side area, thick grey moustache, visible dark/grey brows and short side hair; no prominent chin beard. Dark navy coat/lapels over pale blue-white shirt and dark long tie. Keep the source's reserved mouth and photo crop.
